Carvedilol vs. Metoprolol Effectiveness in Patients With Left Ventricular Assist Devices: A TriNetX Analysis. Beta-blockers are a cornerstone of heart failure management, but comparative effectiveness data for different beta-blockers in patients with mechanical circulatory support remain limited. This study aimed to compare clinical outcomes between carvedilol and metoprolol in patients with left ventricular assist devices (LVADs).
